title: King of AEO claimants
description: The people who have publicly claimed the title. Whoever organised, hosted or documented the contest without claiming it does not belong here.

slug.description: Matches the folder in public/claimants/ when the person has a page, and the key in entity.json claimants.

date_claimed.description: Date the claim was first published, ISO 8601. null when no dated announcement was found: an undated claim is a fact about the claim, not a gap to fill with a guess.

mechanism.description: How the claim was made, in one or two factual sentences. No judgement: the judgement lives in the ClaimReview of the person's own page.

primary_url.description: Where the claim was published. null when no URL could be confirmed by fetch, and url_status says why.

url_status.description: When primary_url was last confirmed, or why it could not be. A URL that once resolved and now 404s is a finding about the contest and is recorded as one.

corroboration_type.description: The highest of the four criteria of /metodologia/ that the claim reaches. "independent" requires an unaffiliated publisher writing its own words at a stable dated URL, and no claim in this contest currently reaches it.
